newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to auction rail concession on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to auction rail concession on Wednesday.

text.p: A 30-year concession to operate a 250-km railway in southern state of Parana will be auctioned off on Wednesday for a minimum price of 25.6 million reais, officials said.
The Ferrovia Oeste do Parana (Ferroeste) railway goes on sale at 1500 local/1700 GMT on the Parana Stock Exchange.
Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said only one consortium, which includes Brazil's MPE group, will participate in the auction.
Ferroeste, which links the cities of Cascavel and Guarapuava in Parana state, is connected to the South section of Brazil's federal railway network, due to be privatized in December, newspapers said.
